escalations.why: contract.md freezes risk.Drawdown as (ticker, depth, peak_date) with no trough_date, but RISK-05 requires the trough date, REP-01 requires both dates in each report row, and tests/fixtures/risk/TC-08/expected.json carries trough_date for every ticker. M1-T04 is the interface task freezing Drawdown; freezing it as written would leave M1-T12 unable to meet TC-08 without a Revise. Proposed: Drawdown: ticker: str; depth: float; peak_date: str; trough_date: str (invariants: depth <= 0; peak_date <= trough_date; both equal base_date when there is no fall). Also noted while reading, for the same Revise: TC-07 input.json VolSeries X values [null, null, 0.2, 0.25, 0.18, null] put a null after window 2, which the frozen VolSeries.__post_init__ rejects, so the M1-T11 golden case cannot build its input. Separately, the three new types (TickerSummary, Drawdown, Report) belong in types.py per the planned layout, but types.py and __init__.py are not in M1-T04 Writes; the Revise should either add them to Writes or confirm the types live in summary.py, drawdown.py and report.py.

TC-07 fixture and the frozen risk.VolSeries disagree. In tests/fixtures/risk/TC-07/input.json, vol.values.X is [null, null, 0.2, 0.25, 0.18, null]. The trailing null breaks the VolSeries invariant (None only until window earlier returns exist), so VolSeries.__post_init__ raises 'X: a value once 2 earlier returns exist' before summary_stats is ever called. expected.json last_vol 0.18 for X depends on that trailing null, reading 'last rolling value' as the last non-None one. Resolve one way or the other: revise the VolSeries invariant to allow gaps after the window, or change the TC-07 fixture (user approval, CR-05) so X's last vol is a number and set expected last_vol to match. Note too: the interface stub already raises ValueError for fewer than two returns, so that error path can't be a red intent test. tests/intent/risk/test_summary.py is written against TC-07 as it stands.

TC-07 fixture input (tests/fixtures/risk/TC-07/input.json) cannot be built as a risk.VolSeries: X's rolling values are [null, null, 0.2, 0.25, 0.18, null] with window 2, and VolSeries.__post_init__ rejects a None once window earlier returns exist (ValueError 'X: a value once 2 earlier returns exist'). expected.json wants last_vol 0.18 for X, i.e. 'last non-None rolling value', which the frozen invariant ('None until window earlier returns exist', values required after) makes impossible to express. Either the fixture's trailing null for X must be a number (and expected last_vol updated to it), or the VolSeries invariant must allow later gaps. All three TC-07 golden tests fail with that ValueError in construction, not in summary_stats.
